metadata.title: Open-source social-science Agent Skills library
metadata.description: Macro-scan, personal-anchor, metacognition-audit — social-science methods that run inside your own agent. One command to install; analysis runs in your agent, not on this site.

hero.subtitle: Openwisdom packs methods from psychology, sociology, history, political science, and economics into agent skills — macro-scan, personal-anchor, and metacognition-audit. Install them into the agent you already use. Analysis runs in your agent, not on this site.

diagram.ariaLabel: Coordinate-field diagram: three value axes — macro, anchor, metacognition — with a copper datum cross marking your position

install.cliNote: Interactively pick the agents to install into — project-scoped or global.
install.githubNote: The skill source files are the single source of truth. Browse, clone, or download the repo directly.
install.manualNote: Or clone the repo and copy the skill directories you need into your harness's skills directory.

harness.label: One command, into the agent you already use

scenarios.title: Three scenarios, three acts of orientation
scenarios.subtitle: Each scenario is a runnable analysis workflow: when to use it, step-by-step inquiry, output structure, bias checkpoints.

macroScan.name: Macro Scan
macroScan.tagline: Break a situation, an industry, or a system into structure: actors, incentives, constraints, and trajectories.
macroScan.when: When a complex situation demands seeing the whole board before judging.

personalAnchor.name: Personal Anchor
personalAnchor.tagline: Place your situation on historical and social coordinates: which curve you are on, which stratum you stand on.
personalAnchor.when: For long-horizon choices — career, city, direction — when you need to know where you stand.

metacognition.name: Metacognition Audit
metacognition.tagline: A checkup for your thinking: expose biases, blind spots, and evidence gaps instead of polishing conclusions.
metacognition.when: After a conclusion forms and before it ships, when thought quality matters.

layers.title: Scenarios cite theory; theory supports scenarios
layers.description: Scenario skills cite discipline reference cards in their workflows — each card defines one theory or method, its boundaries, and common misuse. Knowledge is layered and composable, not one monolithic prompt.

disciplines.title: Five disciplines, the skeleton of the library
disciplines.subtitle: Each discipline ships official reference cards that scenarios actually cite — no empty taxonomy.

psych.name: Psychology
psych.desc: How individuals perceive, decide, and err

socio.name: Sociology
socio.desc: How groups, structures, and institutions shape behavior

history.name: History
history.desc: Path dependence and cycles in the long run

paths.title: Three paths, one source of truth
paths.subtitle: Whichever path you take, the content comes from the same GitHub repository.

cli.title: Openwisdom CLI
cli.desc: One command, interactively installed into multiple agents.

github.title: GitHub repo
github.desc: Browse the source, clone, or download a release.

manual.title: Manual copy
manual.desc: Download a zip or copy skill directories into your harness.

provenance.title: Official and community: layers, not two products

official.title: Core-maintained
points: The three scenarios and five-discipline references tied to the product narrative
A higher bar for quality, style, and citability

community.title: Community-grown
points: Merged into community/ via GitHub PR
Spec and basic review bar, growing with the community

contribute.title: Contribute a reference card or a scenario
contribute.note: No web upload or moderation backend in v1 — everything goes through GitHub PRs.

finalCta.title: Install macro-scan into your agent first
finalCta.description: Start with one command. Then trigger macro-scan in your agent and run your first structured analysis.
